description: This file is a shell script for testing Git rebase autosquash and autosquash-related functionalities. It includes setup, test cases, and utility functions to validate the behavior of auto fixup, auto squash, and rebase instruction handling.

methods.name: test_auto_fixup
methods.description: Performs a test for automatic fixup behavior with given parameters and verifies the rebase result.

methods.name: test_auto_squash
methods.description: Performs a test for automatic squash behavior with given parameters and verifies the rebase result.

methods.name: test_auto_commit_flags
methods.description: Tests rebase autosquash with different commit flags and verifies outcomes.

methods.name: test_auto_fixup_fixup
methods.description: Tests complex fixup and squash commit scenarios to verify correct autosquash operation.
